program_terms.applies_to: owner of immovable property in Albania for the duration of the permit (co-owners of half qualify)
program_terms.quote: Një leje qëndrimi e përkohshme për përdorimin dhe disponimin e pasurisë së paluajtshme në Republikën e Shqipërisë mund t’i lëshohet një shtetasi të huaj sipas këtij ligji dhe që dëshmon pronësinë e një pasurie të tillë të paluajtshme
program_terms.notes: Law 79/2021 approved 24.6.2021 and in force 15 days after publication in the Fletorja Zyrtare (art. 148); the publication date is not printed in this consolidated text, so valid_from is the year only. No minimum value is set in the law; procedures and criteria by Council of Ministers decision (art. 84.4).

program_terms.applies_to: first permit (up to 1 year)
program_terms.quote: me “leje qëndrimi për përdorim të pasurisë së paluajtshme në pronësi” me afat deri në 1 vit për herë të parë
program_terms.notes: Law 79/2021 approved 24.6.2021 and in force 15 days after publication in the Fletorja Zyrtare (art. 148); the publication date is not printed in this consolidated text, so valid_from is the year only. Maximum length of the first permit.

program_terms.applies_to: renewal, each year while the criteria are met
program_terms.quote: e ripërtërtishme çdo vit nëse i huaji vazhdon të përmbushë kriteret e përcaktuara në ligj
program_terms.notes: Law 79/2021 approved 24.6.2021 and in force 15 days after publication in the Fletorja Zyrtare (art. 148); the publication date is not printed in this consolidated text, so valid_from is the year only.

program_terms.applies_to: co-owner
program_terms.quote: Leja e përmendur në pikën 1 mund t’i lëshohet një shtetasi të huaj, i cili është bashkëpronar i 1/2 së pasurisë së paluajtshme.
program_terms.notes: Law 79/2021 approved 24.6.2021 and in force 15 days after publication in the Fletorja Zyrtare (art. 148); the publication date is not printed in this consolidated text, so valid_from is the year only. Co-owners of half of the property may receive the permit. Printed as the fraction 1/2.

program_terms.applies_to: investor (amount not set in the law)
program_terms.quote: Vlera e investimit përcaktohet me udhëzim të përbashkët të ministrit përgjegjës për çështjet e rendit dhe sigurisë publike dhe ministrit përgjegjës për ekonominë.
program_terms.notes: Art. 85/1 added by Law 43/2025 of 26.6.2025; its in-force date is not printed in this consolidated text, so valid_from is the year only. Amount left to a joint instruction of the interior and economy ministers (not stored). Other conditions: five Albanian employees per foreigner, wages at least the national average for the posts, activity not loss-making.

program_terms.notes: Art. 85/1 added by Law 43/2025 of 26.6.2025; its in-force date is not printed in this consolidated text, so valid_from is the year only.

program_terms.applies_to: renewal of the investor permit if conditions unchanged

program_terms.notes: Art. 85/1 added by Law 43/2025 of 26.6.2025; its in-force date is not printed in this consolidated text, so valid_from is the year only.

program_terms.applies_to: after the second three-year permit expires (2 + 3 + 3 years)

program_terms.notes: Art. 85/1 added by Law 43/2025 of 26.6.2025; its in-force date is not printed in this consolidated text, so valid_from is the year only. No single number is printed; the permanent permit follows the end of the second three-year permit.

program_terms.notes: Art. 85/1 added by Law 43/2025 of 26.6.2025; its in-force date is not printed in this consolidated text, so valid_from is the year only.

program_terms.applies_to: investor in strategic sectors, family members and key staff (not more than 5 persons with permanent contracts)

program_terms.notes: Law 79/2021 approved 24.6.2021 and in force 15 days after publication in the Fletorja Zyrtare (art. 148); the publication date is not printed in this consolidated text, so valid_from is the year only. events.description: The Consell General Economy Committee (meetings 9-19 January 2026) reported the bill on continuity and consolidation of sustainable-growth measures. ledger.contains: Andorran qualified immigration law 2012 (31 pp.): passive residence (residence without gainful activity) by investment (arts. 95-96: EUR 400,000, EUR 50,000/10,000 INAF deposits, 6-month deadline, 90 days a year) recorded earlier; this pass added permit validity and renewal periods (art. 32, incl. Spanish/French/Portuguese nationals), the age limit for adult student children as dependants (art. 91), and the residence-without-work fees of art. 154 (application, initial, renewal, family, certificates, duplicate card). Not in scope and not recorded: work, cross-border, student and family permits; self-employment; residence for professionals with international projection and for scientific/cultural/sporting interest (deposit of EUR 50,000 plus 10,000 per dependant, but qualifying ground is the professional or recognised activity, not the money: decision 15); quotas (set by regulation, no number); sanctions; procedure.

Llei 10/2018 amending the 2012 immigration law (9 pp.): restated art. 96 (EUR 400,000 recorded earlier); this pass added the restated EUR 50,000/10,000 deposits, the event adding life insurance to qualifying assets (in force 14.6.2018), and the new art. 154 fee table for residence-without-work authorisations (6.79 / 224.61 / 56.15 / 22.61 EUR etc.).
